name: alfred_
description: alfred_ is a personal assistant for your working life: it connects your email accounts (Gmail, Outlook, IMAP), calendars and to-do lists, and acts as you — with your explicit approval for anything that leaves the building. Through this connector, Claude can search and read your mail, list what's in your inbox and what needs you, check your schedule and find free time, book and move meetings, create and complete to-dos, look up contacts, tidy your inbox with archive and label sweeps (previewed and confirmed before anything moves, and nothing here can ever delete), read attachments including PDFs, manage the standing rules that sort your mail, and review the reply drafts alfred_'s background assistant prepared overnight. Every write scope is opt-in on the consent screen, sends are previewed before they go, and you can disconnect any time from Settings → Privacy & Security.

_published_faq.name: How do I add alfred_ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add alfred_ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://get-alfred.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the alfred_ MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: alfred_ lists 15 MCP tools, including check_free, create_draft, create_event, create_todo, find_free_time, get_schedule, get_thread, list_calendars, list_todos, reply_to_email, search_work, and send_email.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to alfred_?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to alfred_ in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
alfred_ requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
alfred_ is developed by Knowledge Butler, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
